vsm1.3:95.2: rāgacaritassa ca māyā, sāṭheyyaṃ, māno, pāpicchatā,
vsm1.3:95.3: mahicchatā, asantuṭṭhitā, siṅgaṃ, cāpalyanti evamādayo dhammā bahulaṃ pavattanti.
vsm1.3:95.8: Saddhācaritassa muttacāgatā, ariyānaṃ dassanakāmatā, saddhammaṃ sotukāmatā,
vsm1.3:95.9: pāmojjabahulatā, asaṭhatā, amāyāvitā, pasādanīyesu ṭhānesu pasādoti evamādayo.
vsm1.3:95.12: saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesu saṃvego, saṃviggassa ca yoniso padhānanti evamādayo.
vsm1.3:95.16: hurāhuraṃ dhāvanāti evamādayo dhammā bahulaṃ pavattantīti.
vsm1.3:96.1: Yasmā pana idaṃ cariyāvibhāvanavidhānaṃ sabbākārena neva pāḷiyaṃ na aṭṭhakathāyaṃ āgataṃ,
vsm1.3:96.4: Rāgacaritassa hi vuttāni iriyāpathādīni dosacaritādayopi appamādavihārino kātuṃ sakkonti.
vsm1.3:96.5: Saṃsaṭṭhacaritassa ca puggalassa ekasseva bhinnalakkhaṇā iriyāpathādayo na upapajjanti.
vsm1.3:96.6: Yaṃ panetaṃ aṭṭhakathāsu cariyāvibhāvanavidhānaṃ vuttaṃ, tadeva sārato paccetabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:96.8: ‘‘cetopariyañāṇassa lābhī ācariyo cariyaṃ ñatvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathessati,
vsm1.3:96.10: Tasmā cetopariyañāṇena vā taṃ vā puggalaṃ pucchitvā jānitabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:97.6: atiuccaṃ vā atinīcaṃ vā ujjaṅgalaṃ sāsaṅkaṃ asucivisamamaggaṃ,
vsm1.3:97.8: durūpaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ, yaṃ olokentasseva jigucchā uppajjati, tādisaṃ sappāyaṃ.
vsm1.3:97.13: āṇigaṇṭhikāhato ayopatto vā garuko dussaṇṭhāno sīsakapālamiva jeguccho vaṭṭati.
vsm1.3:97.15: Bhikkhācāragāmopi yattha manussā apassantā viya caranti,
vsm1.3:97.16: yattha ekakulepi bhikkhaṃ alabhitvā nikkhamantaṃ ‘‘ehi, bhante’’ti āsanasālaṃ pavesetvā
vsm1.3:97.18: gacchantā gāvī viya vaje pavesetvā anapalokentā gacchanti, tādiso vaṭṭati.
vsm1.3:97.21: ye acittīkārena yāgubhattaṃ chaḍḍentā viya parivisanti, tādisā sappāyā.
vsm1.3:97.26: Iriyāpathopissa ṭhānaṃ vā caṅkamo vā vaṭṭati.
vsm1.3:98.9: yaṃ dassanamatteneva pītipāmojjaṃ janayati, evarūpaṃ sappāyaṃ.
vsm1.3:99.7: tena tena ekapaṭṭaṃ vā dupaṭṭaṃ vā
vsm1.3:100.1: Parivesakā panassa ye honti abhirūpā pāsādikā
vsm1.3:100.9: Iriyāpathopissa seyyā vā nisajjā vā vaṭṭati,
vsm1.3:101.6: Sambādhasmiñhi okāse cittaṃ bhiyyo sammohamāpajjati, tasmā vipulaṃ mahākasiṇaṃ vaṭṭati.
vsm1.3:101.7: Sesaṃ dosacaritassa vuttasadisamevāti idaṃ mohacaritassa sappāyaṃ.
vsm1.3:102.3: Buddhicaritassa senāsanādīsu idaṃ nāma asappāyanti natthi.
vsm1.3:102.10: tasmā gambhīre darīmukhe vanappaṭicchanne hatthikucchipabbhāramahindaguhāsadise senāsane vasitabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:102.14: Sesaṃ rāgacaritassa vuttasadisamevāti idaṃ vitakkacaritassa sappāyaṃ.
vsm1.3:102.15: Ayaṃ attano cariyānukūlanti ettha āgatacariyānaṃ pabhedanidānavibhāvanasappāyaparicchedato vitthāro.
vsm1.3:103.1: Na ca tāva cariyānukūlaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ sabbākārena āvikataṃ.
vsm1.3:103.2: Tañhi anantarassa mātikāpadassa vitthāre sayameva āvibhavissati.
vsm1.3:103.4: Tasmā yaṃ vuttaṃ cattālīsāya kammaṭṭhānesu aññataraṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvāti ettha
vsm1.3:103.14: cariyānukūlatoti imehi tāva dasahākārehi kammaṭṭhānavinicchayo veditabbo.
vsm1.3:104.1: Tattha saṅkhātaniddesatoti cattālīsāya kammaṭṭhānesūti hi vuttaṃ,
vsm1.3:105.5: vikkhittakaṃ, hatavikkhittakaṃ, lohitakaṃ, puḷuvakaṃ, aṭṭhikanti ime dasa asubhā.
vsm1.3:105.8: maraṇānussati, kāyagatāsati, ānāpānassati, upasamānussatīti imā dasa anussatiyo.
vsm1.3:105.9: Mettā, karuṇā, muditā, upekkhāti ime cattāro brahmavihārā.
vsm1.3:105.13: Catudhātuvavatthānaṃ ekaṃ vavatthānanti evaṃ saṅkhātaniddesato vinicchayo veditabbo.
vsm1.3:106.2: ṭhapetvā kāyagatāsatiñca ānāpānassatiñca avasesā aṭṭha anussatiyo,
vsm1.3:107.2: appanāvahesu cettha ānāpānassatiyā saddhiṃ dasa kasiṇā catukkajjhānikā honti.
vsm1.3:107.5: Catutthabrahmavihāro cattāro ca āruppā catutthajjhānikāti evaṃ jhānappabhedato.
vsm1.3:108.1: Samatikkamatoti dve samatikkamā aṅgasamatikkamo ca ārammaṇasamatikkamo ca.
vsm1.3:108.2: Tattha sabbesupi tikacatukkajjhānikesu kammaṭṭhānesu aṅgasamatikkamo hoti
vsm1.3:108.3: vitakkavicārādīni jhānaṅgāni samatikkamitvā tesvevārammaṇesu dutiyajjhānādīnaṃ pattabbato.
vsm1.3:108.5: Sopi hi mettādīnaṃyeva ārammaṇe somanassaṃ samatikkamitvā pattabboti.
vsm1.3:108.7: Purimesu hi navasu kasiṇesu aññataraṃ samatikkamitvā ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ pattabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:109.1: Vaḍḍhanāvaḍḍhanatoti imesu cattālīsāya kammaṭṭhānesu dasa kasiṇāneva vaḍḍhetabbāni.
vsm1.3:110.1: Kāyagatāsati pana asubhāni ca na vaḍḍhetabbāni.
vsm1.3:110.4: Sā ca nesaṃ okāsena paricchinnatā bhāvanānaye āvibhavissati.
vsm1.3:110.5: Tesu pana vaḍḍhitesu kuṇaparāsiyeva vaḍḍhati, na koci ānisaṃso atthi.
vsm1.3:110.8: Tatra hi nimittavaḍḍhanavasena rūpasaññā vibhūtāti vuttā.
vsm1.3:111.1: Yaṃ panetaṃ ‘‘kevalaṃ aṭṭhisaññāya, apharī pathaviṃ ima’’nti (theragā. 18) vuttaṃ,
vsm1.3:111.3: Yatheva hi dhammāsokakāle karavīkasakuṇo samantā ādāsabhittīsu attano chāyaṃ disvā
vsm1.3:111.4: sabbadisāsu karavīkasaññī hutvā madhuraṃ giraṃ nicchāresi,
vsm1.3:111.5: evaṃ theropi aṭṭhikasaññāya lābhittā sabbadisāsu upaṭṭhitaṃ nimittaṃ passanto
